Responsibility: `examples/app-showcase (this lane, as the subsystem the example exercises): the Status × Priority matrix's subtitle says what its cells hold | the dataset and renderer are unchanged`
Thread-read: `6217291496`
Ruling-ref: none. Triage's first grade is `6217291496`.
Serial constraints: no open PR touches `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/reports/`.
Premise to falsify first: on `origin/main`, the report binds `values: ['est_hours']` and its description says "Task counts". The card leans to describing hours (`pivot_tasks` already pivots counts). Confirm that the intent reads that way before choosing.
